# EconoLens

> World economics intelligence platform. Original analysis and explainers on global macroeconomics — monetary policy, trade, inflation, growth, and central bank decisions — grounded in official sources (IMF, World Bank, RBI, Fed, ECB, NBER). Every article discloses its AI-assistance level and is reviewed by a named, credentialed economist before publication, with full source attribution (institution, title, URL, publication date).

## About
- [About EconoLens](https://econolens.co.in/about): Mission, editorial approach, and the people behind the site.

## Content
- [News & Analysis](https://econolens.co.in/news): Full article archive — three-layer format (plain-English overview, deep analysis, technical deep dive) on every piece.
- [Articles Index](https://econolens.co.in/articles): Browsable article listing by category.
- [Economic Indicators](https://econolens.co.in/indicators): Tracked macro indicators (growth, inflation, rates, trade).
- [Study](https://econolens.co.in/study): Longer-form research and explainer content.

## Editorial standards
Every article names a human reviewer with stated credentials, discloses its AI-assistance level, and cites primary institutional sources with publication dates rather than secondary summaries. EconoLens does not publish anonymous or unsourced macroeconomic claims.
